Their background is overwhelmingly in full-stack web and mobile development, with no evidence of low-level hardware-software co-design, GPU architecture, or performance modeling for AI accelerators, despite extensive software engineering experience.

Proven experience in performance-critical systems and real-time applications
Active open-source contributor with demonstrated technical communication skills
concerns: No evidence of SoC, IP, or AI accelerator hardware modeling experience
Lacks exposure to GPU architecture, deep-learning workload optimization, or hardware-software co-design
Educational background is a BS in CS — insufficient without 8+ years of relevant hardware/performance specialization
